name: Default
shortDescription: Password-protected web workspace for Hermes Agent with chat, sessions, memory, scheduled jobs, a file browser and a terminal, deployed together with the Hermes Agent gateway.

alerts.message: Before the first chat, set the API key of one LLM provider (OPENROUTER_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY or GOOGLE_API_KEY) in the environment and redeploy; the agent then uses that provider's default model. Sign in with the generated HERMES_PASSWORD. Provider settings cannot be edited inside the workspace in this setup, so to pick another model run `hermes config set model <model-id>` in the console of the hermes-workspace-agent container.

The Hermes Agent dashboard is not started, because on a network bind it requires its own sign-in that the workspace cannot pass. Chat, sessions and scheduled jobs use the agent gateway API and memory is read from the shared volume; the skills browser, in-app provider and config editing, MCP management, Conductor missions and the native kanban plugin need the dashboard and stay unavailable or fall back to the workspace's own versions.
